notes.title: Meet Fourspell Survivors - The first-ever online co-op survivors game!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41323336/933a52448905dff0958bfd5b5e891019e50b4ba5.gif[/img]

Meet our new game, Fourspell Survivors!

Join friends online to survive endless hordes of monsters in the first-ever online coop "survivors" game! Evolve your base and ultimate spells, defeat bosses and develop the best character builds and party formations. Cooperation is key to survive in this action roguelike with unique characters.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2158750/Fourspell_Survivors_Online_Coop/


We know that many "survivors" games are being released at the moment, but playing together with your friends is so much more fun!

Fourspell is being developed with much care and attention to every detail, and many new mechanics and dynamics.


We can't wait to share a playable version with you guys soon. Until then, please wishlist and tell your friends!

notes.title: We released our new game today with 10% off! Discover Cupid Kiss
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We just launched Cupid Kiss, the newest game in the Cupid universe!
This time we're focusing more on cupid Aelia and her rival Morgan, who wants to disturb the couples' kissing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1954020/Cupid_Kiss/?beta=0

Cupid Kiss is a cute puzzle game where cupid Aelia needs to bring couples together for them to kiss! 💖💖
The people move in small blocks, inspired by those sliding puzzles you played as a kid. But it won't be easy, as her rival Morgan has called her Imp friends and other obstacles to stand in the couples' way!

[previewyoutube=VQEEJNDF-Os;full][/previewyoutube]

The game was made with a lot of love and I hope you'll be able to see it and have fun with it! ✨✨✨

Big hug, Renan

notes.title: New game releasing tomorrow! Memory Shards
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we're releasing a new game!

[previewyoutube=HG51Av5RqTY;full][/previewyoutube]

Memory Shards is a small, introspective visual novel/RPG about a man reliving his past and understanding who he is.

Features memory cards, old RPGs and nostalgia.

Releasing tomorrow on Steam! Wishlist now!😊
